scripts.dev: npm run build -w @nordhaus/domain && concurrently "npm run dev -w @nordhaus/storefront" "npm run dev -w @nordhaus/studio" "npm run dev -w @nordhaus/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nordhaus/domain && npm run build -w @nordhaus/storefront && npm run build -w @nordhaus/studio && npm run build -w @nordhaus/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @nordhaus/domain && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/storefront/tsconfig.json --noEmit
